delivery.heading: How this page is delivered
points: The first thing you see is a compressed still image, sized for your screen. It is the largest element on the page, so the page is usable as soon as it appears.
The video is a separate layer. None of it is downloaded until the page has finished loading and the browser has a moment to spare.
It never plays if your device asks for reduced motion or data saving, it pauses when it scrolls out of view, and it has a pause button.
The footage on EnergyX's own page is not the issue. What's missing there is the delivery step between a finished video and the browser, which is all this page adds.
